section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant characteristics for Study X, which included 253 Portuguese women from the general population aged 18-50 years (M=25.00). The sample had a mean BMI of 21.76 kg/m² (SD=3.26), with 74.70% in the normal weight range, reflecting the BMI distribution in the female Portuguese population.
